programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue
programme.desc: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.

programme.title: Foxy Brown
programme.desc: Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and tough cop Rita Rizzoli is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Hell Up In Harlem
programme.desc: Recovering from an onslaught of bullets that would have killed a lesser man, the Godfather of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs, is back and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: The great Isaac Hayes stars as Truck Turner, who tracks a sadistic pimp through the mean streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Mulholland Falls
programme.desc: In the 1950s, an elite squad of detectives becomes embroiled in a conspiracy and faces a secret the U.S. government is determined to keep hidden.

programme.title: The Great Train Robbery
programme.desc: Sean Connery plans to steal a fortune in gold from a railroad payroll car and joins forces with safecracker Donald Sutherland and his own girlfriend, Lesley Anne Down, in a series of intricately plotted thefts that will test their larcenous skills.

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Rollerball (1975)
programme.desc: James Caan stars as a rollerball champ in this fast-hitting, action-packed glimpse into a dystopian future in the year 2018 where a brutal, no-holds-barred sport takes the place of war, and murder is just a part of the game! John Houseman co-stars.

programme.title: Pray For Death
programme.desc: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

programme.title: Rage Of Honor
programme.desc: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: The Terminator
programme.desc: It's a battle to ensure the future of all mankind from The Terminator in this modern classic!

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.
